items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Dennis was a baritone saxophone player.

ctx.x: No. Out towards Riverside, out there where -- anyway, his son had been in the Army, and he had turned a narcotic addict, and they had a riot out there one night, and the police shot and killed him.
Anyway, getting back to the musical scene, who did I hear? There was a drummer named Blimp -- can't remember Blimp's last name. Dennis was a baritone saxophone player. Arthur
And he had a brother played trumpet, I can't remember his name, first name, presently. And --
